Sunderland vs Jagiellonia Bialystok; UEFA Europa League Round 1
Sunderland vs Jagiellonia Bialystok. UEFA Europa League Round 1.
Stadium of Light.
Sunderland 1-1 Jagiellonia Bialystok: Black Cats maintain Europa League play-off push with draw
Report and reaction as Sunderland are held to a 1-1 draw by Jagiellonia Bialystok at the Stadium of Light in the Europa League; Sunderland struck early in the second half through Timur Tutierov's header; Kamil Jozwiak levelled only minutes later after capitalising on a mistake at the back
Thursday 26 November 2026 22:17, UK
Sunderland were left frustrated again in their Europa League campaign after drawing 1-1 with Jagiellonia Bialystok at the Stadium of Light.
The Black Cats enjoyed the best of the first-half chances through Malick Fofana and Nilson Angulo, but the visitors had an opportunity when Robin Roefs saved Kajetan Szmyt's free-kick.
Sunderland struck early in the second half through Timur Tutierov's header, his second goal in the competition, but Kamil Jozwiak levelled only minutes later after capitalising on a mistake at the back.
A point means the Wearsiders stay in the knockout phase play-off places after being held to their second draw from five games in the competition.
Key moments from the Stadium of Light
30: CHANCE! Le Fee latches on to Vital's underhit back pass and then lays the ball across the area for the unmarked Angulo - only for Kobayashi to get back and make a brilliant goal-saving block.
42: SAVE! Roefs does well at full stretch to get two hands to beat clear Szmyt's well-struck effort.
45+1: CLOSE! So nearly a wonder goal from Hume, but the skipper's thumping volley flashes inches past the far post.
47: GOAL! Tuterov, unmarked at the back post, taps in Le Fee's inviting ball across the six-yard box to lift the Stadium of Light.
52: GOAL! The visitors are level after a terrible mistake at the back by Reinildo, whose underhit back pass is intercepted by Jozwiak, who rounds Roefs, before scoring into the empty net.
61: SAVE! Roefs comes to Sunderland's rescue with an excellent low stop to turn behind Szmyt's drive after the home side again give the ball away in a bad area.
79: CHANCE Imaz's effort is straight at a grateful Roefs when the sub seemed certain to score from 10 yards out after being picked out by a pull back from the left byline.
82: BLOCK! Sunderland corner from the right and a huge block by Romanchuk as Angulo cut back inside and fired goalwards and that looked to be heading for the corner.
90+1: SAVE! Roefs comes to Sunderland's rescue after another mistake at the back, this time from Meunier, who allows Agbonifo to beat him to a long ball up field and break clear one on one with the 'keeper.
digest_he:
סנדרלנד הסתפקה בתוצאת תיקו 1-1 ביתית מול יאגילוניה ביאליסטוק במסגרת המחזור הראשון של שלב הבתים בליגה האירופית. התוצאה הותירה את הקבוצה במקומות המובילים לשלב הפלייאוף, אך היא רשמה בכך את התיקו השני שלה מתוך חמישה משחקים במפעל.

המארחים פתחו את המחצית השנייה בצורה מיטבית כאשר טימור טוטיירוב נגח פנימה בדקה ה-47 והעלה את קבוצתו ליתרון. יתרון זה החזיק מעמד דקות ספורות בלבד, עד שטעודה בהגנת סנדרלנד אפשרה לקמיל יוזביאק לנצל טעות חמורה, לעבור את השוער וגלגל את הכדור לרשת החשופה בדקה ה-52.

עד לסיום המשחק שתי הקבוצות חיפשו הכרעה אך שוער סנדרלנד, רובין רופס, מנע שערים נוספים בעזרת מספר הצלות מרשימות, והמשחק הסתיים בחלוקת נקודות.
